verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents creating a dunning notice for an overdue invoice and sending it from within the product, which covers part of the payment-reminder half of the story. That flow appears to be user-initiated, and the evidence never mentions recurring invoices at all. Missing for 10: recurring/subscription invoice scheduling, automatic (scheduled or rule-based) reminder sending, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set up recurring invoices and automatic payment reminders for overdue customers

citations.quote: Create a dunning notice for an overdue invoice and send it directly from sevdesk. This feature lets you manage every stage of your internal dunning process.
